entries.title: Psalms 105:1
segments: O give thanks to the LORD; call on His name; make known His deeds among the people.

entries.title: Psalms 105:2
segments: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; talk of all His wonderful works.

entries.title: Psalms 105:3
segments: Glory in His holy name; let the heart of those who seek the LORD rejoice.

entries.title: Psalms 105:4
segments: Seek the LORD and His strength; seek His face evermore.

entries.title: Psalms 105:5
segments: Remember His marvelous works which He has done, His wonders, and the judgments of His mouth,

entries.title: Psalms 105:6
segments: seed of His servant Abraham, sons of Jacob His chosen.

entries.title: Psalms 105:7
segments: He [is] the LORD our God; His judgments [are] in all the earth.

entries.title: Psalms 105:8
segments: He has remembered His covenant forever, the word [which] He commanded to a thousand generations;

entries.title: Psalms 105:9
segments: the covenant which He made with Abraham, and His oath to Isaac;

entries.title: Psalms 105:10
segments: and He confirmed it to Jacob for a law, and to Israel [for] an everlasting covenant,

entries.title: Psalms 105:11
segments: saying, To you I will give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;

entries.title: Psalms 105:12
segments: when they were [a few] men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.

entries.title: Psalms 105:13
segments: When they went from one nation to another, from a kingdom to another people,

entries.title: Psalms 105:14
segments: He allowed no man to do them wrong; yea, He reproved kings for their sakes,

entries.title: Psalms 105:15
segments: [saying], Touch not my anointed, and do My prophets no harm.

entries.title: Psalms 105:16
segments: And He called for a famine on the land; He broke the whole staff of bread.

entries.title: Psalms 105:17
segments: He sent a man before them, Joseph, [being] sold for a servant;

entries.title: Psalms 105:18
segments: whose feet they hurt with chains; he was laid in iron,

entries.title: Psalms 105:19
segments: until the time that his word came, the word of the LORD refined him.

entries.title: Psalms 105:20
segments: The king sent and set him free; the ruler of the people, and let him go free.

entries.title: Psalms 105:21
segments: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all he owned,

entries.title: Psalms 105:22
segments: to chain his leaders at his pleasure, and teach his elders wisdom.

entries.title: Psalms 105:23
segments: Israel also came [into] Egypt, and Jacob resided in the land of Ham.

entries.title: Psalms 105:24
segments: And He increased His people greatly and made them stronger than their enemies.

entries.title: Psalms 105:25
segments: He turned their heart to hate His people, to deal craftily with His servants.

entries.title: Psalms 105:26
segments: He sent Moses His servant, [and] Aaron whom He had chosen.

entries.title: Psalms 105:27
segments: They showed His signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

entries.title: Psalms 105:28
segments: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they did not rebel against His word.

entries.title: Psalms 105:29
segments: He turned their waters into blood, and killed their fish.

entries.title: Psalms 105:30
segments: Their land swarmed with frogs in the rooms of their kings.

entries.title: Psalms 105:31
segments: He spoke, and there came [fly] swarms and gnats in all their borders.

entries.title: Psalms 105:32
segments: He gave them hail [for] rain [and] flaming fire in their land.

entries.title: Psalms 105:33
segments: He struck their vines also and their fig trees, and broke the trees of their borders.

entries.title: Psalms 105:34
segments: [He] spoke, and locusts came, and larvae without number;

entries.title: Psalms 105:35
segments: and they ate up all the plants in their land, and ate the fruit of their ground.

entries.title: Psalms 105:36
segments: He also struck all the first-born in their land, the chief of all their strength.

entries.title: Psalms 105:37
segments: He also brought them out with silver and gold; and there [was] not one feeble person among their tribes.

entries.title: Psalms 105:38
segments: Egypt was glad when they departed; for the fear of them had fallen on them.

entries.title: Psalms 105:39
segments: He spread a cloud for a covering, and fire to give light [in] the night.

entries.title: Psalms 105:40
segments: [They] asked, and He brought quail, and satisfied them [with] the food of heaven.

entries.title: Psalms 105:41
segments: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places [like] a river.

entries.title: Psalms 105:42
segments: For He remembered His holy promise [and] Abraham His servant.

entries.title: Psalms 105:43
segments: And He brought forth His people with joy, and His chosen with gladness,

entries.title: Psalms 105:44
segments: and gave them the lands of the nations; and they inherited the labor of the people,

entries.title: Psalms 105:45
segments: so that they might take heed to His statutes and keep His laws. Praise the LORD!
